SELECT id,
    title,
    content,
    cover_image,
    "productId",
    "userId",
    status,
    "isPinned",
    "createdAt",
    "updatedAt",
    "isDeleted"
   FROM "BlogPost"
  WHERE "isDeleted" = false AND status = 'PUBLISHED'::text;

SELECT id,
    "productId",
    url,
    NULL::text AS "storageProvider",
    NULL::text AS "publicId",
    width,
    height,
    NULL::integer AS bytes,
    format,
    "isPrimary",
    "sortOrder",
    "createdAt"
   FROM "ProductImage" pi
  WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM products p
          WHERE p.id = pi."productId" AND p."isDeleted" = false AND (p.status = ANY (ARRAY['ON_MARKET'::"ProductStatus", 'IN_CLOSET'::"ProductStatus"]))));
